name: Oda Saburou Kuon Nobunaga
original_name: 織田 三郎 久遠 信長
source:
Kuon is the head of the Oda Clan and the main heroine of the Sengoku † Koihime series.

She is a visionary leader with a strong vision for the future that she can adapt at need to the situation.  Despite her often cool manner toward outsiders, she agonizes over the sacrifices she needs to make as a leader as much as or more than Kensuke.  Seen as an oddball by many, she just happens to think in a manner that differs from most.  

She frequently agonizes over 'using' Kensuke, but this doesn't stop her from doing so as needed for the good of all.  She is very much a believer in the big picture, even when it hurts.
